metadata.title: How Do Websites Know I'm Not a Robot?
metadata.narration_policy: Narration is SCRIPT.md verbatim, one script section per beat. Beat IDs B01-B10 match script sections 1-10; BVDT, BHTF and BOUT are sections 11, 12 and 13. On-screen-only lines (the typed-then-corrected overview, the prompt shown on screen) and source tags in SCRIPT.md are not narrated.
metadata.visual_policy: Simple illustrative graphics only: a grid of drawn traffic-light squares, wavy letters, a checkbox, a 0-to-1 score dial, a stopwatch, a mouse path, a shield. No Google, reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha or Cloudflare logos, no screenshots of real challenge pages, and no copy of any product's widget or colour scheme. Company and product names appear as plain text only where the narration says them. No person icons: 'me' is a cursor. Every example is an illustration, not data; the only figures on screen are those in SCRIPT.md. The Claude composer, verdict page and channel mark are redrawn bookends, not screenshots.
metadata.library_check: Searched with ./art scenes first, for: grid of traffic light picture squares to select; wavy distorted letters text challenge; I'm not a robot checkbox; checkbox that gets ticked; score dial from 0 to 1 gauge; stopwatch timer seconds comparison; stopwatch; mouse cursor path movement trace; shield protecting a website from bots; traffic light; typed then corrected overview sentence; two readings of one sentence old versus new; bar comparison humans versus bots accuracy and time; humans versus bots race; background signals cookies browsing history mouse movements; before and after number drop 91 percent. Checked renderable with ./art scenes --check: ClaudeComposerAsk, BrutalistHesitantWriter, ClaudeVerdictArtifact, LogoOutro and their 916 variants. Reused: ClaudeComposerAsk, BrutalistHesitantWriter, ClaudeVerdictArtifact, LogoOutro. Genuine misses (PUNTs): the I'm-not-a-robot checkbox and the stopwatch; no library match for the traffic-light grid, wavy letters, 0-to-1 score dial, behaviour signals or shield, so B02 and B04-B10 are planned as custom Manim scenes. Leads judged from their search descriptions only (files not opened) and rejected: BrandBoondoggleScore (a 0-100 gauge for another film's score table), CursorLayer (a macOS pointer overlay on a real app shell), AlgArtSeedGrid (a generative-art seed grid), BarChart (single-value bars; B08 needs ranges and an under-1-second sliver), CCShell (a Claude Code terminal shell).

portrait_layout.rule: In 9:16, all text and labels sit above 86% of the frame height (y < 0.86 * H), leaving the bottom 14% empty.

metadata.reformat: full-length; native portrait graphics; preserve source framing
metadata.portrait_text_rule: Portrait scenes never scale text: font sizes are set directly, with a 32 pt floor (x-height about 87 px at 2160 px wide, above the 72 px rule), and every line sits above 86% of the frame height.
